description: Place a short plaintext fragment into the user's noglow scratchpad (into the slot they configured as their drop target). Use for short text the user will tweak and paste elsewhere (a Slack message, a post draft, a rewrite) — never code, command output, or long content. Capped at 1500 characters. Fire only on an explicit user request.

text.description: The plaintext fragment to drop. Newlines and formatting are preserved. Must be 1500 characters or fewer.

name: drop
title: Drop into noglow
